name: Article 7, after § 2 – 9
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Programme for agile and rapid defence innovation (AGILE)
part_text: 2a. Participation of the associated third countries shall be assessed on a case-by-case basis. An impact assessment shall determine the precise allocation of funding, alongside continuous evaluations of compliance with international law. The Commission reserves the right to suspend all disbursements at any time in the event of concerns regarding the protection of classified information, intellectual property rights, or the potential misuse of funds for unauthorized activities in these third countries.
